units.text: ON MUNICIPAL SERVICE IN THE CITY OF MOSCOW
units.label: Beginning of document · “ON MUNICIPAL SERVICE IN THE CITY OF MOSCOW”

units.locator: Beginning of document
units.text: This Law governs relations connected with the organization of municipal service in the City of Moscow; entry into municipal service by citizens of the Russian Federation and by citizens of foreign states that are parties to international treaties of the Russian Federation under which foreign citizens may perform municipal service (hereinafter, citizens); the conditions and procedure for performing and terminating municipal service; and the determination of the legal position (status) of municipal servants of intra-city municipal entities in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, municipal servants). This Law does not determine the status of holders of municipal offices, because they are not municipal servants.
units.label: Beginning of document · “This Law governs relations connected with the organization of…”

units.locator: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.text: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS
units.label: Chapter 1. GENERAL PROVISIONS

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.label: Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 1. Municipal service in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, municipal service) means citizens’ professional activity carried out on an ongoing basis in municipal service positions filled through the conclusion of an employment agreement (contract).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 2. The employer of a municipal servant is an intra-city municipal entity in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, a municipal entity), on whose behalf the employer’s powers are exercised by the employer’s representative (employer).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) means the head of a municipal entity, the head of the administration of a municipal entity (hereinafter, the head of administration), the head of the administrative office of the Council of Deputies of a municipal entity, the Chairperson of the representative body of a municipal entity (hereinafter, the Chairperson of the representative body), or another person authorized to perform the duties of the employer’s representative (employer) under the charter of the municipal entity.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 4. A municipal service position means a position in a local self-government body of a municipal entity (hereinafter, a local self-government body) provided for by the municipal entity’s charter, with an established set of duties to support the exercise of the powers of the local self-government body or a holder of municipal office, and responsibility for exercising those powers.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 5. Holders of municipal offices mean deputies of representative bodies, members of other elected local self-government bodies, and elected local self-government officials in the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 6. A municipal servant means a citizen who, in the procedure determined by the charter of the municipal entity and municipal legal acts in accordance with federal legislation and the laws of the City of Moscow, performs the duties of a municipal service position in return for monetary remuneration paid from the budget of the municipal entity (hereinafter, the local budget). Persons performing technical support duties for the activities of local self-government bodies do not hold municipal service positions and are not municipal servants.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
units.text: 7. The register of municipal service positions means a list of the titles of municipal service positions classified by local self-government body, position group and functional characteristics. The register may provide for municipal service positions established to directly support the exercise of the powers of a holder of municipal office; such positions are filled by municipal servants through the conclusion of an employment agreement (contract) for the term of office of that person.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 1

units.locator: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service
units.text: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service
units.label: Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service
units.text: 1. Municipal service is performed in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation; Federal Law No. 131-ФЗ of 6 October 2003 “On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation” and Federal Law No. 25-ФЗ of 2 March 2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”; other federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation; the Charter of the City of Moscow; Law of the City of Moscow No. 56 of 6 November 2002 “On the Organization of Local Self-Government in the City of Moscow”; this Law and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow; municipal entities’ charters and other municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service
units.text: 2. Labour legislation applies to municipal servants, subject to the special provisions of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 2

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.label: Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: Municipal service is based on the following principles:
units.label: Art. 3 · “Municipal service is based on the following principles:”

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 1) priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 2) supremacy of the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws over other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and of the laws of the City of Moscow over other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 3) equal access to municipal service for citizens proficient in the state language of the Russian Federation, in accordance with their abilities and professional training, and equal conditions of service regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property and official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership of public associations or other circumstances unrelated to a municipal servant’s professional and work-related qualities;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 4) professionalism and competence of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 5) stability of municipal service;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 6) openness and accessibility of information about municipal servants’ activities;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 7) interaction with public associations and citizens;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 8) uniformity of the basic requirements for municipal service;
units.label: Point 8 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 9) legal and social protection of municipal servants;
units.label: Point 9 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 10) responsibility of municipal servants for failure to perform or improper performance of their official duties;
units.label: Point 10 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 11) independence of local self-government bodies within their powers;
units.label: Point 11 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 12) interconnection and correspondence between the basic conditions of municipal service and state civil service of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, state civil service);
units.label: Point 12 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 3. Principles of municipal service
units.text: 13) non-partisanship of municipal service.
units.label: Point 13 Art. 3

units.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
units.label: Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: Bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow cooperate with local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service, including:
units.label: Art. 4 · “Bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow cooperate with…”

units.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 1) implementing local self-government development programmes in the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 2) studying and analysing the personnel composition of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 3) organizing the provision of additional professional education to municipal servants.
units.label: Point 3 Art. 4

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.label: Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: The powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service include:
units.label: Art. 5 · “The powers of local self-government bodies concerning the…”

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 1) ensuring compliance with municipal service legislation;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 2) advising municipal servants on their legal position and on guarantees associated with municipal service;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 3) forming a personnel reserve for municipal service positions in cases provided for by municipal legal acts;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 4) maintaining a register of municipal servants of local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 5) organizing the provision of additional professional education to municipal servants;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
units.text: 6) resolving other matters related to the organization and management of municipal service in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 5

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.label: Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: The relationship between municipal service and state civil service is ensured through:
units.label: Art. 6 · “The relationship between municipal service and state civil…”

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: 1) uniform basic qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions and state civil service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: 2) uniform restrictions and obligations in the performance of municipal service and state civil service;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: 3) uniform requirements for the training of personnel for municipal service and state civil service, and for additional professional education;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: 4) counting length of municipal service when calculating length of state civil service, and counting length of state civil service when calculating length of municipal service;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: 5) comparability of the basic conditions of remuneration and social guarantees for municipal servants and state civil servants;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 6

units.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
units.text: 6) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have performed municipal service and citizens who have performed state civil service, and for members of their families in the event of the loss of a breadwinner.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 6

units.text: Chapter 2. MUNICIPAL SERVICE POSITIONS

units.locator: Article 7. Municipal service positions
units.text: Article 7. Municipal service positions
units.label: Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Municipal service positions
units.text: 1. Municipal service positions are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with the register of municipal service positions approved by this Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Municipal service positions
units.text: 2. When drawing up and approving the staffing schedule of a local self-government body, the titles of municipal service positions specified in the register of municipal service positions are used.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 7. Municipal service positions
units.text: 3. Positions that are not municipal service positions may be included in the staffing schedule to provide technical support for the activities of a local self-government body.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 7

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.label: Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 1. The register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow is approved by this Law (Appendix 5).
units.label: Part 1 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 2. Municipal service positions are divided into the following groups:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 1) highest municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 2) principal municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 3) leading municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 8

units.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
units.text: 4) senior municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 8
